name: NEON PULSE

scenes.name: Signal
scenes.description: A cyan circular pulse appears at center, expands twice, and a title fades/slides upward.

scenes.name: Orbit
scenes.description: Three neon rings orbit a glowing central sphere; a small magenta particle travels around the rings.

scenes.name: Burst
scenes.description: The rings accelerate, then emit a radial burst of 48 small particles; camera/whole-composition shake peaks briefly at 5.8 seconds and settles by 6.5 seconds.

scenes.name: Resolve
scenes.description: Particles fade, the sphere remains, and the title 'NEON PULSE' plus subtitle 'ONE SCENE. FOUR WORKFLOWS.' resolve cleanly.

output.audio: No audio in baseline render; audio capability tested separately

constraints: No external images, fonts, stock assets or paid APIs
Identical timing and composition across renderers
Render each candidate twice to check reproducibility
